stability: Every entry in `outputs` is stable API: labels, basenames, and the field names/nesting shown in each example. Removing or renaming any of them is a breaking change and requires a TOOL_VERSION bump plus a changelog note here. Files NOT listed here (per-chunk intermediates under enhanced_chunks/, the resampled/ conversion intermediate) are internal and may change or vanish without notice. `description` is one line by design — it is joined verbatim into each get_job_status outputs[] entry as `desc`.

enhanced.description: Noise-suppressed dialogue WAV (DeepFilterNet3; 16 kHz mono default, configurable) — the full source audio enhanced in place, no stem extraction; a LISTENING deliverable — the current model measured worse than the original mix as a transcription input, so the mix is the validated ASR/diarization default and the enhanced track is not recommended there today

contents.format: RIFF/WAVE, 16-bit PCM, mono, one data chunk — full source duration, chunks already concatenated

enhanced.notes: DeepFilterNet3 enhances the whole mix in place: it attenuates non-speech noise around the dialogue rather than extracting a speech stem, so everything keeps its position on the timeline. atten_lim_db caps how much attenuation is applied, enforced full-band by mixing the original back in (never more than N dB quieter); ~0 = bypass, >=100 = unlimited, null = full suppression. rms_db_in/rms_db_out/duration_sec for QC live in the metrics file's output block.

metrics.description: Aggregate enhancement metrics (output summary with RMS in/out, timings, per-chunk summaries) — use for QC via rms_db_in/rms_db_out and locating the enhanced WAV via enhanced_key
metrics.notes: audio_key is the 48 kHz mono WAV the model actually consumed: the source itself on the WAV fast path, resampled/audio_48k_mono.wav (internal) or the wav under media-processing's own run prefix when conversion ran. rms_db_in is measured on that input (the exact window, context padding excluded); rms_db_out on the enhanced output — a drop between them is the noise removed. timing_ms.total_compute is the sum across chunks (the Map runs them in parallel, so wall time tracks the slowest chunk, named in slowest_chunk). Each chunks[].metrics_key points at that chunk's own enhanced_chunks/chunk_NNN.json — an internal file, not contract.

usage.description: Per-state durations and estimated cost, media-processing child included when conversion ran — use for reporting what this run cost
usage.notes: Costs are us-east-1 arm64 estimates, not billing data. media_processing is null unless the source needed format conversion; when present it is {execution_arn, pipeline_wall_sec, estimated_cost, states} sourced from media-processing's own published usage_tracking.json (its states entries follow THAT stack's usage shape, not this one's), and its estimated_cost is already summed into total_estimated_cost. The final 'Usage tracking' states entry estimates its own duration (its terminal event has not fired when it writes this file) and omits retried/incomplete. retried counts billed failed attempts; incomplete is true only for an attempt with no terminal event in the history.
